invariant: After syntactic command selection, captured colors are interpreted using the command color grammar and HColorSet; an unknown color yields a command execution error, including when a richer ColorParser alternative fails and the simple alternative captures a shorter name.
causal_divergence: Rust note patterns approximate color with a delimiter class and store arbitrary names without validating execution. In #back:LightBlue: cargo, Java PART2 cannot end before colon, the simple alternative captures #back, and Colors/HColorSet throws; Rust currently emits a successful SVG.
planned_change: Use registered command captures and source-derived ColorParser alternative/termination semantics for sequence color execution. Reuse the existing source-derived color name domain, extend validation only according to HColorSet/Colors, propagate badColor through ParseError rather than accepting a fallback paint color. Preserve valid simple/composite/gradient/transparent colors and distinguish unsupported paint residue.
perturbation_axes: simple/composite color grammar, delimiter placement and unknown names
